title: A finite annihilator for a constructible torsion curve sheaf
statement: For a curve coefficient pair P over an algebraically closed field and a constructible underlying torsion abelian sheaf P.F, there is a natural number n > 0 such that n times the identity morphism of P.F is zero.

source.place: Definition 03RW and Lemma 095E; parent lem-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-sub-quotient proof step 1 (agent-written finite bound used in the reduction to Proposition 09BH (2))

proof.text: Apply the uniform finite stalk-cardinality bound on the Noetherian curve. Noetherianity follows from finite type over the field, and quasi-compactness from the curve structure morphism.

Let N be the bound. Choose n = N factorial, which is positive including N = 0. At each algebraic-closure residue-field point, the stalk group is finite and nonempty, so its cardinality is positive and at most N. Nat.dvd_factorial makes its cardinality divide n. Mathlib card_nsmul_eq_zero' (Lagrange) and mul_nsmul show n annihilates every element of the stalk group. Additivity of sheafFiber identifies the stalk map of n times the identity with this zero homomorphism.

Use the source library's Scheme.sheafHom_ext_of_sheafFiber_map_algClosurePoint, the jointly faithful consequence of geometric-stalk conservativity, to conclude n times the identity of F equals zero. This avoids forming an image and separately invoking exactness.

proof_origin.place: Original finite-bound argument, with cardinality maximum and factorial followed by direct jointly faithful stalk extensionality; implemented by U2.
